hooks.command: in=$(cat); [ "$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; [ -n "$RALPH_HOME" ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; git status --porcelain | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' || exit 0; out=$( { npx pnpm typecheck && npx pnpm lint; } 2>&1) || { echo "Checks failing — fix before finishing:" >&2; echo "$out" | grep -E 'error|warn' | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"Plan approved. First save the last plan-explainer summary you printed in chat as <plan>.simple.md next to the plan file and link it. Then publish its ticket breakdown as GitHub issues per the to-tickets SKILL.md (CLAUDE.md § Planning) — blockers first, label ready-for-agent, ## Blocked by #N. Do not start implementing."}}'

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -E '/\.claude/plans/[^/]+\.md$' | grep -qv '\.simple\.md$' || exit 0; jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"Plan file updated. Before ExitPlanMode, print a fresh /plan-explainer summary of the whole plan in the chat (plain-language before/after per section, example, benefit, Mermaid flow) — see .claude/skills/plan-explainer/SKILL.md, plan-mode paragraph."}}'
